raw: {"analysis": "TXC correctly handles the health check by keeping it independent of the read-only flag, and provides a clear timing plan for the config flag propagation (toggling 10 minutes before deployment). HXN suggests returning 200 for write attempts, which could be misinterpreted as allowing writes, and lacks a precise pre-deployment timing for the flag toggle. TXC also includes a more detailed rollback and post-migration plan, making it more actionable with fewer follow-up questions.", "verdict": "TXC"}
